magnitude of the factor of safety.

tensile  strength  of  400  MPa.  Using the  factor  of  safety  =  2.5,  find  the  load  P  applying

Q.3 Two rods are connected utilizing a cotter joint. The inside diameter of the socket and the
outside  diameter  of  the  socket  collar  are  50  and  100  mm,  respectively.  The  rods  are
subjected to a tensile force of 50 kN. The cotter is made of steel 30C8 with a tensile yield
strength of 400 MPa, and the factor of safety is 4. The width of the cotter is five times of
thickness.  Calculate  the  width and  thickness  of  the  cotter  based on  shear and  bending
failure.
